answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor to an attestation chain where zero-knowledge proofs verify execution validity without leaking private state. At network dawn, validating each new node in an economic island requires recursive staking with exponential capital exhaustion, scaling attacker cost superlinearly as O(k^n). Swarming actors must burn rare saffron token reserves per replica, making massive clone deployment mathematically and financially unviable.
